status: pre-data protocol, archive-free numerical control before native training; native fit/dev only on explicit release after raw reference test
estimand: Reverse spatial bottleneck E->H retaining information about the native central 12-site occupancy word V across the hidden gap at fixed eligible stratum and temperature. Not a center encoder, MI estimate, a physical-target-trained encoder, or a microscopic order parameter. No topology lookup, target score/labels, alternative targets, or raw/probe output may enter this learner.
reads: Only dedicated unlabeled-fit.npz, unlabeled-dev.npz with exact keys parent, shell, stratum, word plus pilot-frozen eligible.npy. Authorizing parent separately owns evaluation, finite-composition beta-zero null and all held-out release. Each role sampled independently from its own parents, no cross-role donors. Native parent order immutable; first 512 fit rows nested in all 2048, dev 512 distinct. Each has 128 anchors. Store model NPZ, hard dev maps and registered initial random maps privately; no examples in public reports.
model: 386 little-endian packed oriented vacancy bits (49 bytes, tail padding ignored), signed -1/+1, float32. All bits -> affine width 32 -> tanh -> affine K=4 -> 1-temperature softmax q; test code argmax (ties smallest). No nuisance input to encoder, dropout, noise, STE or regularization. NumPy default_rng(seed) draws independent Glorot uniform W1 then W2, zero biases. Critic C[K,4096] initially zero residual per exact word plus A[K,12] initially zero on all signed center-word bits (least-significant bit first); score q dot (C[:,v]+A bits(v)). Hard score substitutes one-hot H. No symbol assignment learned on evaluation.
fit: For each batch of 128 eligible focal anchors sampled uniformly with replacement subject to >=8 distinct supporting fit parents for that stratum: native V plus 7 negatives from uniform distinct OTHER fit parents in same stratum; then one uniform within-parent stratum opportunity, allow repeated word values but never negative donor parents. InfoNCE = 8-way categorical NLL, differentiate soft q. NumPy Adam lr .001, betas .9/.999, eps 1e-8; no decay/clipping. No pooling across temperatures. Fresh starts 260511,260512 at each nested 512/2048 parent count; save checkpoints and timing after 256/512/1024 updates. Frozen primary always 2048 parents 1024 updates (two starts averaged as paired scores, not pseudo-replicated). One optional descriptive 2048-update doubling for both full-data starts only if the ensemble paired hard native-minus-broken dev score improves from 512 to 1024 with grouped two-sided 95% lower bound >0, runtime fits remaining cutoff and parent releases extension. No other extensions/sweeps. Persist both seeded untrained encoders.
held_apart: Stateless score_block(model,shell,word,stratum,eligible,seed) on disjoint parent blocks. Common deterministic seed and parent allocation for every model. Random permutation of role parents (seed 88001), disjoint consecutive blocks of 32, never mix roles or temperatures. In block and stratum require >=9 supporting parents. For EVERY supported focal anchor independently draw 8 other distinct parents uniformly without replacement, then one uniform eligible word from each. Contrast native index vs 7 common distractors; separately replace native by eighth independent word keeping distractors. Hard and soft native log p vs broken log p, also each minus -log(8); zero native-minus-broken expectation if exchangeable pairings, with caveat about uniform-parent vs anchor-weighted donor distribution. Parent dependence, repeated anchors, repeated donor use are contained inside disjoint groups. 95% t ratio interval on group totals, no across-anchor/seed standard errors. Opportunity support, distinct supporting parents per stratum and donor reuse reported. Development ladder differences evaluated paired on identical frozen groups; 80%-power two-sided approximate detectable effect (tcrit+.842)*SE. Symbol H and H|stratum entropies nats on all frozen eligible anchors.
control: Archive-free planted synthetic E,V,stratum: 2 latent bits copied with noise into disjoint bands of signed shell bits and into full-word bits; remainder independent, stratum-independent latent labels. Dedicated 512 train/512 dev synthetic parents, 32 anchors each, eight strata, seed 260511, 1024 steps. Independent broken synthetic dev sampled with unrelated word latent; score both with identical within-stratum parent-mismatch scheme. Gate: true hard native-minus-broken lower95>0.05 nat, disconnected hard |mean|<=max(.02,2.5 SE). Publish timing and support; no hyperparameter rescue after failure. This strong control establishes numerical recoverability, not sensitivity to native or physical target margin.
restrictions: No new physical draws or simulations, no Modal, no native validation/test, no evaluation role access in learner. K8/unconditional forbidden without separate prospective release. Conditional contrastive effect and its detection floor are not physical-target log gains. No label or score access by spatial worker. One native thread; discovery cutoff 21:00:25Z and stop 21:45:25Z.
